description: DAO-PROP on a writable copy: for each DAO property type Boolean 1, Byte 2, Integer 3, Long 4, Currency 5, Single 6, Double 7, Date 8, Binary 9, Text 10, LongBinary 11, Memo 12, GUID 15, BigInt 16 and Decimal 20, a Property AP_<type> is created on the Database with a constant of the matching VARIANT type; Inherited, Type and Value of the draft are read; it is appended; Type, Value and Inherited are read again from the held object and from Properties.Item(name). Each append's own result is in its call record.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
